beats.summary: Jim wraps a gift for Dwight, who tries and fails to open it quickly.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Happy Holidays, Dwight. But do not open it till Christmas.

Dwight: Really? If I can skin a mule deer in less than ten minutes, I ought to be able to cut my —
[STAGE] sets briefcase on desk and sits in chair, desk and chair are made of paper, Dwight crashes to the floor

beats.summary: Phyllis organizes a Moroccan-themed Christmas party and enforces the theme by removing non-themed decorations.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: This is the first Christmas party I am throwing as head of the party planning committee. The theme is "Nights in Morocco".
Phyllis: Angela. You're going to move this for the party right? It's not on theme.

beats.summary: Angela is upset about Phyllis removing Christmas decorations and suspects blackmail.

evidence.snippet: Angela: I am not going to judge Phyllis for desecrating Christmas. There is one person who will though and Phyllis just stuffed him into a drawer.
Phyllis: Oh, I don't think it's blackmail. Angela just does what I ask her to do so I won't tell everyone that she's cheating on Andy with Dwight.

beats.summary: Dwight buys out all the popular unicorn dolls to resell at a profit.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Every year I do research to determine which toy will be the most popular of the Christmas season. This year it's a doll. Half girl, half unicorn.

beats.summary: Michael hosts a drunken party with unusual drinks and Meredith drinks excessively.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This is equal parts scotch, absinthe, rum, gin, vermouth, triple sec, and two packs of Splenda. Call it a one of everything.
Meredith (drinks): Oh… my… GOD!!! Hit me again.

beats.summary: Michael attempts an intervention for Meredith's drinking during the party, but Meredith denies being an alcoholic.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I am not asking her to stop drinking. I am imploring her to quit being an alcoholic.
